import tablica
import pygame

pygame.init()

width, height = 800, 600

display = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

tabs = tablica.Tablica(display, width, height)

def draw_axis(thickness):
    pygame.draw.line(display, (0, 0, 0), (0, height/2), (width, height/2), thickness)
    pygame.draw.line(display, (0, 0, 0), (width/2, 0), (width/2, height), thickness)

draw_axis(2)

while True:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            pygame.quit()
            sys.exit()

    tabs.update()
    tabs.draw()
    clock.tick(60)
    pygame.display.flip()
